Anthracnose.symptoms: Dark black sunken lesions on leaves, flowers and fruits. Fruit rot may occur under humid conditions.
Anthracnose.preventive: Remove infected leaves and avoid excessive moisture.

Bacterial Canker.symptoms: Cracks in bark, leaf spots and branch dieback.
Bacterial Canker.preventive: Prune infected branches and disinfect tools.

Cutting Weevil.symptoms: Leaves show cuts and feeding damage caused by insects.
Cutting Weevil.preventive: Maintain orchard hygiene and monitor pest population.

Die Back.symptoms: Drying of twigs and branches from the tip backward.
Die Back.preventive: Prune affected branches and apply fungicide.

Gall Midge.symptoms: Leaf curling and gall formation due to larvae.

Healthy.preventive: Continue regular monitoring and nutrient management.

Powdery Mildew.symptoms: White powder-like fungal growth on leaves and flowers.
Powdery Mildew.preventive: Improve air circulation and avoid overcrowding.

Sooty Mould.symptoms: Black fungal coating on leaves reducing photosynthesis.
Sooty Mould.preventive: Control sap-sucking insects like aphids and mealybugs.

Black Rot.symptoms: Brown lesions on leaves and black shriveled fruits.
Black Rot.preventive: Remove infected berries and maintain ventilation.

ESCA.preventive: Prune infected wood and maintain vine health.

Leaf Blight.symptoms: Brown necrotic patches spreading across leaves.
Leaf Blight.preventive: Avoid excess humidity and remove infected leaves.
